author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Demon's Souls PS5 PC Port Out NOW! Another PS5 "Recomp"
summary: Video Game Esoterica covers the AnyPS5 tool that translates PS5 games like Demon's Souls Remake to native PC ports, reporting full GPU translation functionality.

blocks.text: The video discusses AnyPS5, a GitHub project that translates PlayStation 5 titles into native Windows executables rather than emulating the console. The creator explains that the tool has reached complete GPU-side translation, meaning every shader and hardware call from the PS5 can be converted to PC equivalents. Demon's Souls Remake and Astro Bot are cited as early examples of games processed through this pipeline, alongside mentions of existing PS5 emulation efforts such as KytyPS5 and SharpEmu.

Players interested in running PS5 exclusives on PC hardware may benefit from a translation layer that avoids the overhead of full system emulation. However, the video's claims reflect the creator's own assessment and have not been independently verified by this publication. Results will vary depending on system configuration, driver support, and the specific title. Users must supply their own legally obtained game files and any required firmware; the Hub does not provide or link to copyrighted material.
